hero.title: I'm Mert. I study cybersecurity and look after servers.
hero.valueProposition: I'm doing the CyberMACS master's in applied cybersecurity. Before that I looked after the network and servers of the cybersecurity centre at Kadir Has University for two years, and I still write code for a couple of research projects there. This site has the things I've worked on and a few longer posts.

philosophy.title: About me
content: So far my work has been fairly ordinary infrastructure and data work: keeping a research lab's machines and network running, building a data portal and a few data pipelines for TÜBİTAK projects, and helping with papers on power grid data and EEG signals. I try to keep things simple and write down how they work.
Outside of that I'm in AFAD's search and rescue team and teach some of their courses. I climb when I can, and I keep a large music library that turns up in the blog now and then.

timeline.description: Full EU scholarship. The first year is at Kadir Has University in Istanbul and SRH Berlin, the second at UKIM in Skopje. Courses in cryptography, network security and applied cybersecurity.
Research on EEG-based brain–computer interfaces. I also teach the lab sessions of undergraduate MIS courses on algorithms and operating systems.
Ran the network and servers of the Center for Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection, and kept the GPU machines going for the lab's machine learning projects.
Urban and mountain search and rescue under AFAD and INSARAG standards. As a certified AFAD instructor I also teach disaster preparedness and USAR courses.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: If you're working on something in security, infrastructure or research data and want to talk, send me an email.
